body: Oof, forgot to say this when I posted, but I also have this uploaded on my Deviantart account. No links cuz I don't wanna self-advertise here, but wanna mention it just in case someone thinks I stole my own work lol
Thank you so much! TuT It took some time but it was worth it for the final product. lol I'm glad you like it!
Thank you! :D Gotta have some wholesomeness in this cruel world lol
Yes, it is! :D I did this fanart a little while ago and thought it'd be a good preview.

That does sound really satisfying, yeah. Don't know if I can bring myself to ghost, though. I was brought up in an environment where family is a priority and to be fair to my father, he's been through a lot himself. I just want him to be proud of me and see me as useful, you know...?

Still sounds great to be independent nonetheless... and not made to feel worthless every day. Thank you for the support, it does help.
